comment: One entry per standalone addon built from the bundle's source by tools/standalone/build.js. key = the feature's registry key. Optional per entry: db (default <folder>DB), slash (fallback slash words when the feature declares none), bindings (secure button name suffixes, e.g. RareButton). features = folders under KroolWorldForever/Features; embedded = provider folders loaded for their data only, never enabled. curseId stays empty until the CurseForge project exists. relations = CurseForge project slugs.

addons.title: KW Quest Trash
addons.notes: Marks quest items you can safely delete on their tooltips, from QuestieDB's quest data.

addons.title: KW Kill Value
addons.notes: Gold per kill on creature tooltips: coins plus the drop table at vendor or Auctionator prices.

addons.title: KW Setups
addons.notes: Save a character's action bars, keybindings, macros, layouts and settings, and copy them to another character.

addons.title: KW Rare Alert
addons.notes: Tells you when a rare enemy is near, with a button and a key that target it and put a raid marker on it.

addons.title: KW Disenchant Value
addons.notes: On weapon and armor tooltips: what the item disenchants into and what that is worth at Auctionator's prices.

addons.title: KW Camp Guide
addons.notes: Hover a campfire or a camp object for the buff it gives at your level.

addons.title: KW Skill-Up Odds
addons.notes: In the crafting window: the chance each recipe gives a skill point, tuned by your crafts, and the cheapest next point.

addons.title: KW Sayge's Fortune
addons.notes: When Sayge at the Darkmoon Faire can give you your next fortune.

addons.title: KW Least Valuable
addons.notes: Marks the bag slot worth the least, so you know what to sell or drop first.

addons.title: KW Quest Reward Value
addons.notes: Marks the quest reward choice worth the most with a coin on its button.

addons.title: KW One-Button Fishing
addons.notes: One key casts your line and reels in the bite.

addons.title: KW Reagent Uses
addons.notes: Hold Ctrl over a crafting material to see every recipe that uses it, colored by your skill, with where each recipe is learned and which of your characters know it.
